text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Christmas approaching... <chrname> had 
received invitations to appear at various 
events.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accepting every single request will impact 
her most important training. <chrname>'s wishes 
come first, but—
choice_data_list:
(I really want to live up to those 
expectations if I can.)

(I'd like to live up to their expectations 
if I can...)

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
I have heard. That you are having trouble 
balancing your work and training.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"If so, leave it to us! ♪ After all, we're 
pros at this! We'll support you 
flawlessly!"
choice_data_list:
(True, she really is the ultimate 
support……!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having gained a reassuring ally... 
we decided to accept the requests we chose 
after consulting with <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I had my script checked for one of 
them... the special Christmas talk show.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—If that's the case, how about 
incorporating your own experiences into 
this section?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Concrete anecdotes enhance empathy. They 
should captivate the audience even more.
choice_data_list: I see... I'll make the adjustments!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it sounds like it's going to be a 
great talk show. To think you'd be 
appearing on stage as well."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: I see. You two have a great relationship.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, the two of you lately have been 
truly imposing and dignified. A talk show 
is a fitting choice."
choice_data_list: You've influenced me as well, you know.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: To me?
choice_data_list:
It's about speaking for the sake of the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of her ideals, Speed Symboli 
spoke openly without hiding a thing... and 
her tone was always one of steadfast 
self-affirmation.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...If that is the case, it surely isn't 
just me. You too—Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. Because... I want to answer their 
expectations.”

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry, Speed Symboli. We won't be 
able to celebrate Christmas lavishly this 
year, but..."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"What are you talking about? You're here, 
along with Grandma Mejiro and my 
grandpa... Everyone gathered for me. 
That's more than lavish enough!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
“Now then, let's raise a toast with our 
prayers! To the future of racing! —To our 
Speed Symboli!”

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Now then! Lastly, a word of advice from 
me.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
When the time comes, look into each and 
every one of their eyes... and convey your 
feelings without holding anything back.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: It will. —Your heart will reach them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with their help... we managed to 
successfully complete every single request 
by Christmas Eve!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I had them look over my lessons for 
one of those events... the Christmas live 
concert.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Yes, it feels great!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was between training 
sessions, she's getting into great shape, 
isn't she?♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, it feels different from usual... 
Like I can sense some real fighting 
spirit?
choice_data_list: I think I was inspired by you.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Haiseiko worked tirelessly for her fans 
and lived up to their expectations... and 
the fans embraced her with everything they 
had.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that, <chrname> seemed to have decided... to 
take another step forward in her 
relationship with her fans.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Then I'm sure <nickname>-chan's fans will 
be overjoyed!
choice_data_list:
I know it'll be that much harder, so I'll 
support you!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
By all means! I'm sure <nickname>-chan will be 
overjoyed.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"—Trainer! Look, here's my outfit for the 
Christmas live♪"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe, isn't it cute? ...Alright, I'm 
feeling motivated~! Let's head straight 
into training!"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, I'll be fine! After all, my Trainer 
is watching over me."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"Because you're fighting alongside me! 
—So, please tell me I'm cute... just one 
more time♪"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"...With our Trainer's support, an 
Umamusume becomes invincible♪"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
So... here is some advice from me to you, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Make sure you give <nickname>-chan plenty of 
praise, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with their help... we managed to 
successfully complete every single request 
by Christmas Eve!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was one of those events... an early 
Christmas party that I attended with St 
Lite.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: ...<chrname> is truly wonderful, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
A presence truly worthy of the guest of 
honor. It is undoubtedly the fruit of 
everything you've built to this day.
choice_data_list:
I'm sure part of it was following your 
example.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Oh? For example?
choice_data_list:
Something like... staying proud and 
dignified...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
St. Lite's dignified bearing, taking pride 
in her own achievements... Deeply 
impressed by her presence, <chrname>—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At this party, more than usual... she 
seemed conscious of how she presented 
herself.
choice_data_list: Thank you for coming along with me.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind. Though I'm not particularly 
fond of parties..."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Watching you and <chrname> is truly a delight, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Yes. It almost feels as though...—

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"—Just a little is fine. After all, this 
surely will be... my last time with you, 
Sir."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"Let us appreciate one another... There is 
no need to rush... Let us walk slowly, and 
share our memories together."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"That way... even this moment will become 
a precious memory—"

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: In short, what I wished to say was...

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to follow my example, allow me 
to offer one piece of advice.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Remember this well. —This view before you, 
which you will surely take pride in 
someday.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with their help... we managed to 
successfully complete every single request 
by Christmas Eve!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: —Oooooh! <chrname>~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...This year's Christmas was the absolute 
best~! I got to see so much of <chrname>!"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Tomorrow's the main event, but... it 
feels like our Christmas is already 
complete! All that's left is watching the 
race~♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
—Isn't that wonderful? So many people were 
delighted!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I have to praise <nickname>-chan—and Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
For her sake and for the fans, I planned 
far ahead and poured my whole heart into 
giving it my all.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Good work. —You gave it your all.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure <nickname>-chan has so much she wants to 
tell you, too.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"With lots of love♪ Thank you for all your 
hard work!"

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
The bond between Trainer and Umamusume... 
It is precisely because it runs so deep 
that countless records have been set... 
and the racing world has achieved the 
status it holds today.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
You and <chrname> are already further along that 
path.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
That is why we are so delighted. To still 
witness bonds tied so strongly, even now.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"Racing is our 'essence'... How rare it is 
to find someone who approaches it with 
that same dedication—"

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
For your caring heart toward her... I 
thank you from the bottom of mine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they too... surely did not achieve 
great feats all on their own. By their 
side was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There stood her Trainer, bound to her by a 
strong bond of trust.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. How adorable. It's written all 
over your face.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"I want to go to <chrname>'s side... right now... 
is what I thought."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Leave the rest to us. You should head back 
to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas♪

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Have a wonderful night. —Please, have a 
safe trip!
